props.gloss_en: for the sin of forbidden relations exile comes to the world: they are exiled, and others come and dwell in their place
for the sin of idolatry exile comes to the world
for the sin of [failing to] release the Sabbatical and Jubilee years exile comes to the world
as it is said: 'for all these abominations the men of the land did...' (Lev 18:27)
and it is written: 'and the land was defiled, and I visited its iniquity upon it...' (Lev 18:25)
and it is written: 'that the land not vomit you out when you defile it' (Lev 18:28)
and regarding idolatry it is written: 'and I will cast your carcasses...' (Lev 26:30)
and it is written: 'and I will make your sanctuaries desolate...' (Lev 26:31)
'and you I will scatter among the nations' (Lev 26:33)
regarding the Sabbatical and Jubilee years it is written: 'then the land shall be paid her Sabbaths all the days of desolation, and you in the land of your enemies...' (Lev 26:34)
and it is written: 'all the days of desolation it shall rest' (Lev 26:35)
